questions.question: Were preprocessing steps (imputation, encoding, scaling, feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, calibration) fitted on training folds only, with no information from test/validation data used to fit them? Report whether the article explicitly limits fitting to training folds or leaves it ambiguous whether test data could have leaked into preprocessing.

Was the test or validation set used only for final evaluation, or was it also used for tuning, threshold selection, calibration, or model selection? Report any described reuse of held-out data for decisions other than the final reported performance.

Are the same patients (or the same patient contributing repeated records) kept mutually exclusive across train/validation/test splits? Report whether the article states patient-level splitting, or instead splits records randomly in a way that could place the same patient on both sides — noting that temporal or site splits are not necessarily mutually exclusive by patient.

Are predictor/feature values those actually available at the stated prediction time, rather than measurements recorded at a different clinical period or after the prediction point? Report whether the article distinguishes the predictor availability time point from the outcome ascertainment window, or uses post-prediction information.
